description: This file defines the PasswordHash class which provides methods for hashing passwords and verifying password hashes using PHP's built-in password_hash and password_verify functions. It serves as a utility component within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling password security.

classes.name: PasswordHash
classes.description: A utility class that wraps PHP's password_hash and password_verify functions for secure password management.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of the provided password using a default cost setting.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a password against a given hash, returning true if they match.
